title: Agent Pay failure: the keyid is not in the key directory
summary: An agent sends a signed request whose keyid the verifier cannot find in the Mastercard directory, for example an unregistered or delisted agent. Mastercard's decision table says to block.

steps.label: Signed request, unknown keyid
steps.detail: The request carries complete Signature-Input parameters and the Agent Pay tag, but the key was never registered or is no longer listed.

payload.content:
# Illustrative example, Agent Pay developer guides as read 2026-10-11. Values are made up.
GET /checkout HTTP/1.1
Host: shop.example.com
Signature-Agent: "https://agent-keys.example.com/"
Signature-Input: sig1=("@authority" "@path");created=1791720000;expires=1791720480;keyid="poqkLGiymh_W0uP6PZFw-dvez3QJT5SolqXBCW38r0U";alg="ed25519";nonce="e8N7S2MFd/qrd6T2R3tdfAuuANngKI7LFtKYI/vowzk=";tag="Agent-pay-auth"
Signature: sig1=:jdq0SqOwHdyHr9+r5jw3iYZH6aNGKijYp/EstF4RQTQdi5N5YYKrD+mCT1HA1nZDsi6nJKuHxUi/5Syp3rLWBA==:

steps.label: Look up keyid
steps.detail: The directory returns no key for this keyid.

steps.label: Block
steps.detail: Mastercard's merchant decision table says a key not found in the directory means block. The agent never reaches the card form.

steps.label: Log the attempt
steps.detail: The merchant or edge keeps the event for bot analytics. Mastercard publishes no event name for it.
